title: Record I — Vel-an
rawPages:
Kael orren vel.
Orsha orren vel.

Vel-thae vaen.
Vel-an thae.
Thae Iven.

segments.baseText:
Shared mind remains in the Hearth.
The Hearth witnesses.

Those who returned remain as part of the Hearth.
Memory remains.

The origin-kind took warmth.
Orsha took what belonged.

The warm-one is witnessed.
The Hearth is alive.
You are not alone.
